authorization: User yes to measuring the eight existing controllers, corrected refit, and enforcing the gate before evaluation

diagnostic.loss: Unweighted active-coordinate flow MSE on the original fixed 128 validation queries
diagnostic.comparison: Native, full-history steering, and episode-reset steering on identical noisy actions and timesteps

gate_interpretation: Prospective practical screening thresholds fixed before candidate measurements; not statistical evidence of adaptation or robot success

refit.initialization: Clone preserved full terminal learner state into a fresh output; preserve policy, Adam and sampler/global/flow RNG
refit.only_training_change: Replay scheduled held-out losses with the corrected truly-relative plateau rule, then continue the same learner
refit.checkpoint_selection: Lowest held-out flow loss, never simulator success
refit.readout: Only after corrected convergence and a candidate-bound gate result; original six held readouts remain held

budget.billing: All diagnostic, setup, queue, retries, refitting and readout allocations charged cumulatively; no other campaign budget borrowed

storage.existing_inputs: Read-only original source cache, models and eight finalized recoveries; no old run contract or active worktree changes
